description: Land Acquisition - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2002/63 of 20.01.2017 and Ex. Gaz. No. 2233/14 of 22.06.2021
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, including amendments to survey plans, lot descriptions, property details, and acquisition procedures. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their features, claimants, and acquisition purposes. The content falls squarely within the "Land Gazettes" category as it focuses on land and property-related administrative matters without involving government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
